## Scope

What does this change do? What is intentionally unchanged?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Requested behavior is covered by explicit checks.
- [ ] No unrelated office design or feature work.
- [ ] Existing agent settings and identities are preserved, or a known unmet requirement is stated honestly.
- [ ] No real user/team data, credentials, screenshots, logs or machine-specific deployment details.

## Verification

List the exact commands run and their results. Separate fixture tests, authenticated live checks and production readiness. Do not mark unexecuted checks as passed.

## Risks / rollback

What could fail, and how is the change reversed without losing user or agent state?

## Authorization

Does this start workers, change agent configuration, add infrastructure, deploy code or require spending? Those actions need separate explicit approval; a repository PR does not grant it.
